       - `doi_def->map.std->lvl.local`
       - `doi_def->map.std->lvl.cipso`
       - `doi_def->map.std->cat.local`
       - `doi_def->map.std->cat.cipso`

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in the `net/netlabel/netlabel_cipso_v4.c` file are related to addressing warnings that were reported by Syzbot regarding the `netlbl_cipsov4_add_std` function. The addition of the `__GFP_NOWARN` flag to the `kcalloc()` calls prevents the kernel from issuing warnings when the size passed to `kcalloc()` is too large, which is particularly relevant since the size values originate from user space. This change aims to improve the robustness of the function by suppressing unnecessary warnings while maintaining the functionality of memory allocation.
